title: SATURDAY EASY CARDIO
subtitle: SATURDAY. EASY CARDIO. TIMED WORK. OPEN UP, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN KEEP THE ENGINE TICKING. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. SATURDAY. EASY CARDIO. FIFTEEN MINUTES. TIMED WORK. OPEN UP, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN KEEP THAT ENGINE TICKING. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THAT KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. SATURDAY EASY CARDIO DONE. ENGINE HONEST. BALANCE OWNED. NOW GET BACK TO WORK WITHOUT SITTING LIKE A BLOODY FOLDED DECKCHAIR.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: SCAPULAR ROW
exercises.cue: STAND TALL OR HINGE LIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN SLOW. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH AND CHEST OPENER. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: SCAPULAR ROWS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. OPEN THE CHEST AFTER THAT DESK. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE STARTING A LAWNMOWER.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE SHOULDERS LOOSE.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. CHEST UP. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. OWN THE BALANCE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. STEP BACK. CHEST UP. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT WOBBLE ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY WEATHERVANE.

exercises.name: STEP-UP
exercises.cue: LOW STAIR. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEEL. STAND TALL ON TOP. ALTERNATE LEGS. STEADY PACE. THIS IS YOUR CARDIO ENGINE. NO RUSHING.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. TWO ROUNDS. FORTY SECONDS. LOW STAIR. DRIVE THROUGH THE HEEL. STAND TALL. ALTERNATE LEGS. STEADY PACE. THIS IS YOUR CARDIO. DO NOT RUSH LIKE YOU ARE LATE FOR THE BLOODY BUS.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. CATCH YOUR BREATH. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: WALKING LUNGE
exercises.cue: STEP FORWARD. BOTH KNEES SOFT. CHEST UP. SHORT STEPS IN PLACE IF SPACE IS TIGHT. KEEP MOVING. EASY CARDIO. DO NOT RACE.
exercises.speakStart: WALKING LUNGES. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS. STEP FORWARD. CHEST UP. SHORT STEPS IF SPACE IS TIGHT. KEEP MOVING. EASY CARDIO. DO NOT RACE LIKE A BLOODY GREYHOUND.

exercises.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS
exercises.cue: HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS. DRIVE THE KNEES IN SHORT AND CLEAN. EASY STEADY PACE. ARMS BRACE. CORE WORKS. NO FLOPPY HIPS.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. TWO ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS. HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS. DRIVE THE KNEES IN CLEAN. EASY STEADY PACE. THIS IS TIMED CARDIO. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY SEAL ON A ROCK.

exercises.name: BODYWEIGHT SQUAT
exercises.cue: FEET ABOUT SHOULDER WIDTH. SIT BACK. CHEST UP. HEELS DOWN. STEADY RHYTHM FOR THE CLOCK. LIGHT STRENGTH FINISH. DO NOT BOUNCE.
exercises.speakStart: BODYWEIGHT SQUATS. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS. SIT BACK. CHEST UP. HEELS DOWN. STEADY RHYTHM. LIGHT FINISH. DO NOT BOUNCE LIKE A BLOODY PING PONG BALL.
exercises.speakDone: SQUATS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
